meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先把你对 NanoClaw 的本地改动整理成一份迁移指南,再在干净的上游代码上重新套用这些改动来完成升级,避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把本地改过的 NanoClaw 升级到上游新版本,或想生成/更新迁移指南时,让 Claude 用它来做。

say.text: 帮我把这个 NanoClaw 分支迁移到上游新版
say.note: 先提取改动,生成或更新迁移指南。

say.text: 直接按现有指南升级,跳过提取
say.note: 适用于已有指南且认为它仍然有效。

say.text: 我刚才改了 src 下的文件,帮我确认意图
say.note: Claude 会用子代理分析差异并让你确认。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude extracts your local customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a migration guide, then reapplies them on a clean upstream checkout to upgrade without merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: When you ask to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream, or to create or update the migration guide for that fork.

say_en.text: Migrate this NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream
say_en.note: Extract changes first, then create or update the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade using the existing guide, skip extraction
say_en.note: For when the guide already exists and is current.

say_en.text: I modified files under src — help me capture the intent
say_en.note: Claude runs sub-agents to analyze diffs and confirm with you.
